draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.25, the 64th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 3rd of 21 at S. He went 36th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (64th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Jordan Poyer. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 66 tackles in 2019, 4th of 21 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the New York Giants. 74 career games and 71 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 4 AV in 2025 against a career-best 6 in 2021. Strengths in 2025: missed tackle rate 3.1% (96th percentile), passer rating allowed 71.0 (88th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 safety who played: 74.7% season snap share against a median of 59.9%, above the norm.
